intelligence.essence: Smart Worlds is the table of contents for all Smart Lists. Worlds — two separate lists (joined vs created by you), plus your world and worlds you are connected to · Connections — lists in any grouping (family, business, project, any) · Smart Notes — collections (all Smart Notes related to one thing together) · Your Notes — lists of your own regular notes · Posts You Shared — lists of posts you shared. One table of contents, everything list-shaped under it.
